paper_id: MegaScale-MoE_ Large-Scale Communication-Efficient Training of Mixture-of-Experts Models in Production
title: MegaScale-MoE: Large-Scale Communication-Efficient Training of Mixture-of-Experts Models in Production
motivation: MoE训练中通信占43.6%前向时间/32%总时间,随硬件提升通信瓶颈愈发严重
problem_framing: 将MoE层的并行策略按attention和FFN组件分别定制以减少通信量
key_insight: 将MoE层限制在单节点内利用NVLink高带宽,避免跨节点通信成为瓶颈
method_signature: 定制通信高效并行+运算符级通信计算重叠+通信压缩
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Context parallelism faces workload imbalance due to causal masking, zigzag策略仍难以完美平衡
evidence_for_taste: communication accounts for 43.6% of the total time
TP communication overhead can even surpass the computation time
removing the need for host interference
CP attention, however, faces workload imbalance
thinking_moves: 将通信瓶颈归因于硬件计算提升快于带宽提升的趋势
按组件类型(attention/FFN)定制差异化并行策略而非统一方案
利用NVLink域内高带宽特性将MoE层约束在节点内
通过tile级细粒度融合通信进计算kernel避免host干扰
用选择性激活重计算换取内存减少同时不增加关键路径延迟
